class DSU:
    self.parent = list(range(n))
    self.size = [1] * n
    self.weight = [0] * n
    if self.parent[x] != x:
        self.parent[x] = self.find(self.parent[x])
    return self.parent[x]
    (rootx, rooty) = (self.find(x), self.find(y))
    if rootx == rooty:
        return
    if self.size[rootx] < self.size[rooty]:
        (rootx, rooty) = (rooty, rootx)
    self.parent[rooty] = rootx
    self.weight[rootx] += w
    self.size[rootx] += self.size[rooty]
    self.size[rooty] = 0
    return self.find(x) == self.find(y)

from collections import deque
import sys
MOD = 1000000007
n = int(input())
costs = list(map(int, input().split()))
m = int(input())
adj_list = [[] for _ in range(n)]
for _ in range(m):
    (u, v) = map(int, input().split())
    adj_list[u - 1].append(v - 1)
visited = [False] * n
min_cost = 0
num_ways = 1
is_reachable = [[False] * n for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    if not visited[i]:
        min_cost += costs[i]
        q = deque([i])
        visited[i] = True
        is_reachable[i][i] = True
        while q:
            node = q.popleft()
            for neighbor in adj_list[node]:
                if not visited[neighbor]:
                    visited[neighbor] = True
                    min_cost += costs[neighbor]
                    q.append(neighbor)
                    is_reachable[node][neighbor] = True
                    for prev_node in range(n):
                        if is_reachable[prev_node][node] and is_reachable[node][neighbor]:
                            is_reachable[prev_node][neighbor] = True
dp = [[0, 0, 0] for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
    dp[i][0] = min_cost if visited[i] else float('inf')
    dp[i][1] = sum((dp[j][2] for j in range(n) if is_reachable[i][j]))
    dp[i][2] = 1
    for neighbor in adj_list[i]:
        if not visited[neighbor]:
            dp[i][0] = min(dp[i][0], costs[i] + dp[neighbor][0])
            dp[i][1] += dp[neighbor][1]
            dp[i][2] += dp[neighbor][2]
print(min_cost, dp[0][2] % MOD)
